what: Authoritative Walrus Memory write count for this demo's agent (read-only queries, no writes)

agent_id_as_used_by_memwal.meaning: delegate public key (Ed25519), stamped on every blob as memwal_agent_id

sources.namespaces: Walrus Memory relayer listNamespaces (memory_count per namespace, relayer index)
sources.on_chain: Sui Mainnet: Walrus Blob objects owned by the account owner, filtered by memwal_package_id and memwal_agent_id metadata

notes: walrusBlobObjectsOwned and memwalBlobsForThisPackage count every Walrus Blob object owned by the account owner wallet, which other agents (other delegate keys) also write to.
memwalBlobsForThisAgent counts only blobs whose memwal_agent_id equals this demo's delegate public key and whose memwal_package_id is the Mainnet MemWal package.
The account owner address and account object ID are deliberately left out of this file.
